The refunds table matches the three refunds Alpha reported (orders 231, 234, 235 with the same amounts), so I can proceed. Next I need the customer list, so I'll pull the orders.
The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly. The customers in the orders are acme, birch, and cobalt, so I'll get each one's net balance before recording any payouts.
Acme's net balance is 36083, which matches its orders (18974 + 17109) with no refunds against it. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 10785 matches its orders (21055 + 11644 = 32699) less its refunds (17910 + 4004 = 21914). Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.

Cobalt's net balance of 29267 matches its orders (14171 + 16756 = 30927) less the order 235 refund (1660). The refunds table matched Alpha's report, and all three balances reconcile, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout recorded successfully. Birch's balance of 10785 reconciles with its orders less refunds 231 and 234, so I'll record that payout next.
Birch's payout recorded successfully. Cobalt's balance of 29267 matches its orders (14171 + 16756 = 30927) less the order 235 refund (1660), so I'll record that payout to finish the batch.
